answer: Say you have agents wandering a proving ground, each identity needing a rare nectar token to issue receipts. Tokens regenerate at a fixed umber-node pace, say 1 per 1.2s. Each Sybil must burn a new token—no sharing. Cost per fake: 1.2s of queue time, no parallel shortcuts, because tokens don’t pool from bulk farms. General rule: bottleneck on renewable scarce inputs, linear time cost per identity.
